summary: Gravel car park at the edge of a sports oval, no homes close.
reasons: Gravel car park beside open oval
Room for a van, access via park road

drivers.seclusion: Backs onto a large oval; pool, tennis courts and club buildings are non-residential. No homes seen.
drivers.access_and_room: Formed gravel car park with a park road in; large open area, vehicles and a truck parked there.
drivers.traffic: Internal park car park, little through traffic.
drivers.convention: Shared club car park; other vehicles present, so a van will not stand out.

flags: Mapped parking aisle tagged private, so club rules may apply
Light poles beside the car park
sun_shade: Mostly open; trees shade the south-west part, sun from the east.
cannot_judge: Whether the car park is locked after hours

best_section.where: Eastern end of the gravel car park, beside the oval boundary
